reviewedRevision: 927535d plus the rework in this commit
process: Lean final review at the user's request: the known 3-course shortfall went straight to a retrofit, followed by one independent review round. Its MEDIUM finding and one LOW item were fixed and verified by re-running the reviewer's own mechanic, pilot and blind scripts, one clean-worktree run and the browser check, without a second review round.
independentProbes: On the final files the reviewer's mechanic bots (jump only; jump plus wall-run; jump, wall-run and kick at edges) all fail courses 5, 6, 9, 12, 16 and 20, and courses 3, 4, 8, 11, 14, 18 and 19 need the wall-run. The reviewer's pilot (state seen 0.35 s late, 8 px jitter, 6 seeds) cleared mastery courses 16-20 in 29 of 30 runs (97%), losing up to about 1.2 lives per run on Storm Line, and cleared the rebuilt courses 6 and 12 in 6 of 6 runs each. Eighty-seven blind policies won at most 4.6% of runs on any course (cap 25%). In the review round physics, determinism, progress stores and text fit passed, the pilot cleared 120 of 120 runs at 0.25 s and 119 of 120 at 0.35 s, and jump windows were 26-38 px (240-345 ms).

findings.observation: Only 3 courses, with no select or continue. There are now 20 data-driven courses with chalk walls for wall-running, bare walls for kicks, slick faces, relay pads that refill energy, accurate EN/ZH tips, a course select and env.progress continue, and the file is split into five modules.

Review finding: courses 6 (Slick Ledge), 12 (Pit Climb) and 16 (Slick Spire) started on a top roof with a 26 px gap, so one ordinary jump skipped the kick, chalk and slick content. The runner now starts inside the pit on all three, a slick mark on the left boundary wall forces a low kick on 6 and 16, course 12 needs a kick across before the chalk run, and the tips for 5, 6, 9, 12 and 16 describe the real routes.

Review finding: a player following the bare-wall prompt could not discover the kick-climb rhythm on the shafts of 5 and 9. The prompt now reads 'Space: kick across, then kick the opposite wall.' (空格：蹬向对面，再蹬对面墙。) and the tips explain the rhythm.

openNotes: Courses 15 (Needle Roofs) and 17 (Thin Air) are precision-jump courses that need no wall mechanic.
Storm Line (18) is the hardest course for the 0.35 s pilot, which lost one run of six there.
Course 20 was left unchanged; it already defeats all three mechanic bots.

browser.method: Official Claude in Chrome extension, local server; real clicks on Start and the language toggle, synthetic in-page keys; only DOM text and the canvas were read.
observed: English: Start opened course 1 of 20 (Gutter Row) with energy, lives, relay pads and the prompt 'Hold Right and tap Space to jump the gaps.' unobscured.
Loss: holding Right without jumping fell into the gaps, costing lives (5 to 3) and returning the runner to the relay pad with 'RELAY pad: energy refills here.'
Chinese: the HUD, course name (滴水檐巷), status line, prompt and how-to-play text switched fully to Chinese.
Chinese 390 px phone frame (388 px inner, no horizontal overflow): touch buttons 左, 右, 跳跃 / 蹬墙 and 沿墙跑（按住） with course 1 readable.
Not covered in the browser: a course win and the rebuilt courses 6, 12 and 16; the reviewer's pilot and the quality tests cover them.
